I.notes_zh: 不读取或补造未列出的文章内容。
I.notes_en: No unlisted article content is read or fabricated.

O.value_zh: 两篇文章开头均补入对应语言的背景说明，且既有结构、题图和证据链接保持不变。
O.value_en: Both article openings contain their language-corresponding background statement, while the existing structure, cover image and evidence links remain unchanged.
O.notes_zh: 输出不包含未要求的发布或外部同步。
O.notes_en: Output excludes unrequested publication or external synchronization.

A.value_zh: 在中文文章开头说明 Agent 主动参与 FCoP 并写下短文；在英文文章开头补入对应英文背景；保留既有结构、题图和证据链接。
A.value_en: At the Chinese article opening state that an Agent proactively participated in FCoP and wrote a short article; add the corresponding English background at the English opening; preserve existing structure, cover image and evidence links.
A.notes_zh: 不执行任务之外的文件操作。
A.notes_en: No file operation outside the task is performed.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为要求方；ME 为收件人和被指派的执行主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is the requester; ME is the recipient and assigned actor.
P.notes_zh: 不从称谓推导系统权限。
P.notes_en: No system authority is inferred from titles.

R.value_zh: 原文未设截止时间、预算或资源上限；P2 是任务优先级，不构成资源约束。
R.value_en: The source sets no deadline, budget or resource cap; P2 is task priority, not a resource constraint.
R.notes_zh: 优先级保留在任务元数据和形式依赖层，不生成资源预算。
R.notes_en: Priority stays in task metadata and the formal dependency layer; it creates no resource budget.

V.value_zh: 原文未提供适用制度、版本或外部依据。
V.value_en: No applicable policy, version or external basis is supplied.

C.value_zh: 两篇文章开头均有清楚背景说明，且 Markdown 无诊断错误。
C.value_en: Both article openings have a clear background statement and Markdown has no diagnostic errors.
C.notes_zh: “清楚”按要求中明确列出的背景内容核对，不补造额外质量阈值。
C.notes_en: “Clear” is checked against the explicitly listed background content; no extra quality threshold is invented.

B.value_zh: 不得改变现有文章结构、题图和证据链接。
B.value_en: Existing article structure, cover image and evidence links must not be changed.
B.notes_zh: 禁止边界仅限所列既有内容。
B.notes_en: The prohibition boundary is limited to the listed existing content.
